boundary.capacity_note: The 2GiB cap is unchanged. The 1117320736-byte official GGUF plus 58720256-byte estimated f16 KV cache at 2048 tokens leaves 971442656 bytes before graph/runtime/other allocations. No fit, peak-memory or throughput result is observed; OOM/refusal/timeout stays failure, with no automatic limit increase.
boundary.client: Fixed loopback client with the reviewed model adapter and one pure replacement helper. The pinned read-only source is hash-checked before import. One initial request, 60-second whole-request deadline, original bounded response retained.
boundary.environment: Fixed cleared environment; no inherited LLAMA_*, proxy, API secrets, auth tokens or cloud credentials. No model/server file/MCP tools, URL fetching, model switching or automatic fallback.
boundary.execution_host: existing disposable GitHub hosted worker only

guardian_lease.channels: Root outer caller renews a root-only lease; guardian validates it before each current-check-bound renewal of a separate root-owned read-only /lease/guardian.json. Worker validates after go, before each launch, around readiness/client pumps, and before success.

boundary.namespace: bwrap --unshare-all with --cap-drop ALL from start; pinned bwrap initializes its private loopback before application execution. Worker and outer owner must observe sole lo UP and zero capabilities before server/client start. No application capability activation helper, host net, authority, credentials, source checkout, home or service paths. Read-only /usr plus only exact runtime/model/client/module; private bounded scratch and output.
boundary.native_budget_claim: None. This standalone synthetic compatibility call does not manufacture a native effect-start receipt, native permission or cost settlement.
boundary.outer_owner: Reuse reviewed Doc-proof/owned_child lifetime and collector with a separately admitted fixed model profile; parent death/stale lease/cleanup remain mandatory.
boundary.output: Only explicit fixed client artifacts and bounded server/runtime observations. Hash inventories and counts, no raw credentials or arbitrary exception output. Server output cannot authorize a native effect.
boundary.parent_owned_lifecycle: Root verifies immutable intake, current cgroup limits and namespace isolation. Worker owns exact server PID/cgroup, bounded readiness, client and log pipes. Finite cleanup reaps both, verifies empty cgroup and removes mounts before final accepted report.
boundary.readiness: Bounded GET /health only in private net before client; no inference warmup. Endpoint absence/malformed status does not retry a model call.
boundary.source_ownership: Outer root verifies root-owned exact immutable intake before read-only bind. One-UID/GID bwrap mapping maps child1000 to existing nonzero host account, leaves outer root unmapped; fixed kernel overflowUID65534 must be observed by owner/worker. Client requires exact UID1000 and source-owner65534 (not arbitrary nonzero ownership). All mapping/mount/root namespace observations must agree before actual execution.

documentation.relevant_flags: Pinned server CLI supports explicit --temp 0 (greedy) and --seed 42; unchanged --jinja uses the GGUF embedded template, unchanged --reasoning-budget 0 requests immediate end of any reasoning allocation. Only Qwen3-specific enable_thinking template kwargs are removed. Offline/no-agent/no-webui/no-MCP and all CPU/context/slots/time/token bounds remain. Flags complement, but never establish, actual namespace/lifetime isolation.
